f.title: Formula versions
f.needFamily: Add a process family first (Process families tab).
f.rule: A version is written and sent for approval; another person with the approve right approves it with a start date. The version it replaces ends the day before.
f.emptyBody: Write the first formula: bulk materials by weight for a batch size, packaging in Nos per pack, and the QC limits.

v.title: {{code}} v{{v}} · {{product}}
v.meta: Batch size {{size}} kg · fill per pack {{fill}}

v.submitted: Sent for approval. Another person approves it.
v.approveEffect: {{code}} version {{v}} comes into force on {{date}}. The version in force now ends the day before. Batches from that date use this version.
v.needApprover: Waiting for someone with the approve right who did not write or send it.
v.withdrawn: Withdrawn. It can no longer open batches.
